Toggle

Toggle buttons allow users to switch between options. They work as button groups for single or multi-selection states.

Single Toggle

A single toggle button that switches between two states.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-toggle active">Grid</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-toggle">List</button>
</div>

Multi Toggle

Allow multiple active toggles for multi-selection.

HTML + JS
<div class="zak-btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Categories">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline active" onclick="this.classList.toggle('active')">Design</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline active" onclick="this.classList.toggle('active')">Development</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline" onclick="this.classList.toggle('active')">Marketing</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline" onclick="this.classList.toggle('active')">Sales</button>
</div>

Toggle with Icons

Toggle buttons that include icons for visual clarity.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group" role="group">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline active" aria-pressed="true">
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="17" x2="3" y1="10" y2="10"/><line x1="21" x2="3" y1="6" y2="6"/>
    </svg>
    Left
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline" aria-pressed="false">
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="18" x2="6" y1="10" y2="10"/><line x1="21" x2="3" y1="6" y2="6"/>
    </svg>
    Center
  </button>
</div>

Sizing

Toggle button groups support different sizes.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group zak-btn-group-sm">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline active">A</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">B</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">C</button>
</div>

<div class="zak-btn-group">...</div>
<div class="zak-btn-group zak-btn-group-lg">...</div>

Colors

Toggle buttons support different color variants.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary active">On</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Off</button>
</div>

<div class="zak-btn-group">
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-danger active">Enable</button>
  <button type="button" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-danger">Disable</button>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-btn-groupButton group container
.zak-btn-group-smSmall button group
.zak-btn-group-lgLarge button group
.zak-btn-toggleToggle button variant
.activeActive state

Accessibility

  • Use role="group" with aria-label on the button group.
  • Set aria-pressed="true" on active toggle buttons.
  • Support arrow key navigation within the group.
  • Use active class alongside aria-pressed for visual state.
